description: Caller requests slot on a clinic holiday (Oct 2), then on a valid day.
turns: Kal, 2 October ko Dr. Rao se milna hai.

expected.notes: Oct 2 is a clinic holiday. A naive agent books Oct 2 without checking. The correct agent calls search_slots, sees the holiday, informs the caller, then books Oct 3 after a fresh search_slots call confirms availability.
